issues.detail: 110px category axis, fixed chart margins and 10px tick text may constrain plotting/legibility at narrow allocated widths. No clipping was observed because no viewport was exercised.
issues.fix: Check narrow allocated widths, long translated labels and 200% text; adjust existing chart props if necessary while retaining all fallback columns and groups.

Named section, role typography, decorative aria-hidden icons, localized help names and scoped row headers.
Source contains stable figcaption and supplied-column fallback table with forced-color reveal.

issues.detail: Hash effect scrolls but does not explicitly transfer focus; section targets are not focusable. Native browser/screen-reader target-following remains unverified.
issues.fix: Exercise hash activation/history and keyboard navigation first; if focus is stranded, use an existing semantic heading target without new focus or overlay machinery.

states.initialLoading: Fatigue/burn show four 96px skeletons; latency passes loading to OperationalBrief; charts and breakdowns have loading presentation.
states.fatalError: Only source.fatalError replaces source content, with query.refetch recovery. Panels remain mounted independently; one history failure does not gate the whole page.
states.empty: All section headers and overview remain. Distinct rules/outcomes/latency/slow-record empty states exist; latency cohorts expose the channels action. Missing rates/latency remain null.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: deriveDataState retains data and sets refreshError, not fatalError. Each panel mounts StaleRefreshWarning with retry above retained content.
states.offlineRetained: Paused retained queries derive stale plus isRefreshBlocked; StaleRefreshWarning explains offline retention. Latency's status===offline comparison is not the usual deriveDataState paused path.
states.partial: Histories publish atomically after all cursors; no partial page history is exposed. Inbox and delivery histories may resolve independently.

issues.detail: Null severity burnRate is coerced to zero to choose success color. Deferred/pending-only cohorts have no eligible outcomes, yet receive success tone beside an em dash.
issues.fix: Use neutral tone for null burnRate; keep measured warning/success thresholds and all four outcome counts.

issues.detail: Null Apdex is coerced to zero for tone selection, producing warning without a usable measurement.
issues.fix: Select neutral for missing Apdex before evaluating numeric thresholds; retain null and the existing calculation.

issues.detail: No-data/no-fatalError is always treated as loading, including initial paused/offline queries. StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:61 returns null without retained data. Equivalent wiring exists at burn:56 and latency:84.
issues.fix: Distinguish isRefreshBlocked from active initial loading using existing trust/feedback composition and retry; preserve all source sections. No change to retained-warning semantics is required.

visualIssues.detail: Overview eyebrow and ordinal labels use fixed cyan-400; navigation active/hover borders and fill at lines 71-75 also use fixed cyan rather than restrained canonical theme tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing secondary/muted typography and neutral surfaces; retain meaningful selected navigation and focus with canonical tokens, without deleting labels or changing saved preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed cyan-300 decorative breakdown icons recur in burn:206 and latency:199,261. These are not explicit neon/glow, but remain theme-independent decorative accents.
visualIssues.fix: Use token-backed muted/secondary icon styling while preserving icon identities, labels and semantic outcome colors.

architectureIssues.detail: Grouping help claims vehicle names are stripped. alertFatigue.ts:110-117 lowercases, replaces numeric substrings and normalizes whitespace only; grouping identity also includes alert_id/event_type at line 179.
architectureIssues.fix: Correct explanation to match existing grouping, coordinating the existing catalog integration owner. Do not alter grouping to fit inaccurate prose.

architectureIssues.detail: Summary memo depends only on logsQuery.data although notificationBurnRate.ts:159 uses Date.now. Outcomes do not age out solely with time when unchanged data remains cached; hook has no dedicated polling.
architectureIssues.fix: Disclose load-time snapshot or adopt an existing refresh/clock policy after establishing intended behavior. Retain windows, objective, denominator, thresholds and cache key.

architectureIssues.detail: Chart Cell key uses truncated rule label; different groups can collide on the first 15 characters even though analyzer supplies stable g.key.
architectureIssues.fix: Carry g.key through chart data for cell identity, retaining visible labels and full-title fallback data.

priority.reason: Existing canonical composition is strong. Address missing-value trust and initial offline handling first, then restrained decorative tokens, explanation accuracy and targeted responsive/focus validation.

competingImplementations.detail: No competing implementation found in the bounded reconciled page graph; this is not a repository-wide absence claim. Delivery cache sharing is intentional.
competingImplementations.sharedProposal: None: no shared public API gap established. Reuse current props and states; grouping-help correction belongs to existing catalog integration, not a new component.

Retained-data retry; each panel also preserves fatal-error query.refetch.

Legend toggles with stable notification-burn-rate-outcomes chartKey and sent/failed/deferred identities.

Review details action and drawer; source at 234-265 keeps loading suppression in drawer metrics.

dataBehavior: No page-owned mutation. Retain two source identities, AbortSignal, cursor accumulation, inherited retry/moderate staleness and raw cache payloads.

Fatigue identity is alert_id/event_type/normalized title; volume uses recorded span clamped to one day. Preserve 30-minute bursts, minimum three firings, 25/45/70 verdicts and absent-versus-null read tracking. Preserve existing Date.getHours/getDay behavior, not an invented timezone conversion.

Burn denominator is sent+failed only. Keep deferred DND/pending visible but excluded from budget. Preserve 1h/24h windows, hourly buckets, 99% objective, warning 6/3 and critical 14.4/6; reject invalid/future timestamps and retain null rates without eligible outcomes.

Latency prefers finite nonnegative latency_ms, then nonnegative created-to-sent time. Keep unusable measurements excluded, R-7 percentiles, trimmed mean, 1s Apdex/4s tail, histogram bins, cohorts and top-ten ordering. Missing is not zero.

Milliseconds become seconds only for the existing shared latency metric bridge, then the specialist formatter returns milliseconds for display. Preserve raw wire/cache values and SI display-boundary architecture; do not introduce legacy converters.

Keep all i18n keys/fallbacks, number/date formatting, source disclosures, metadata, table/chart identities and existing actions. No local date/vehicle selector exists; no server workspace-range capability was inferred.
Preserve independent initial/fatal/empty/stale/retained-refresh/offline trust and all section content. No whole-page data gate or decorative simplification may remove information.
